_note: Optional shadow advisor, off by default. To opt in, copy this file to configs/local/advisor.json, set enabled to true and write a per-session authorization file (see the README). It sends symbols and public market data to the model; never account data. Only enabled, allowed_domains, aggregator_domains, context_url and symbol_url_template may change: the advisor refuses to run if any other value does. context_url and symbol_url_template are empty here (generic reading steps). Set both to https URLs whose hosts are in allowed_domains, with {symbol} once in the template and not in the host (a query string is allowed; a fragment or a port other than 443 is not), to tell the model to fetch that context page and one profile page per symbol. The entry windows come from your strategy config.
